text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen, Familiar!
Big news!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"The upcoming fan meetup event
is gonna be held super close to Grandma's house!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "And then Grandma messaged me saying she's coming to watch! I've gotta make it an incredible live!"
However, a few days after that—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, what on earth is going on?!

Due to circumstances on the amusement park's end where it was scheduled to be held,
the mixer event was called off.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I tried negotiating a few times, but...
I'm sorry, I tried negotiating several times, but...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up so easily!
Grandma's coming to watch, too!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I can't accept this!
I'm going to ask them directly what this is all about!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why!?
Why does it have to be canceled!?
Tell me properly what happened, please!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
My apologies.
The stage has deteriorated more than expected.

text_block_list.name: Staff B
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, the amusement park's management wasn't informed about the live show...
This decision was made purely out of safety concerns. I sincerely apologize.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, a talk show should be fine...

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I see!
If it's on that sort of scale, then—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No! No, no, noooo way!
I'm gonna do a live show right here! I am, I am, I am!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I practiced a whole bunch, you know?!
Even Grandma said she was looking forward to it, you know?!
choice_data_list: The stage is definitely dangerous, so...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's not it at all, you idiot familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Is a talk show really what they're hoping for?
Is that the kind of magic our audience wants most to see?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The stage is supposed to be thrilling, right?!
You want to make everyone who came feel their hearts race, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: When there are people eagerly waiting for me, I don't want to let them down by just phoning it in!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It's dilapidated," "it's dangerous," blah blah blah!
Then what is this stage even here for?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine then! In that case, I'll cast
my very best magic on those stubborn adults!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's magic to make you remember your first dream!
Dream☆Dream☆Come True-!!

text_block_list.name: Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Um... if it's just reinforcing the stage,
we might be able to make it work
with the leftover materials from the other day.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
As for the lighting near the ceiling,
if I ask another department, they might be able to temporarily relocate it...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
See! There are plenty of things you can do!!
Is there anything else?
Keep 'em coming!!

"The staff reviewed safety measures and sprang into action
to ensure the live performance could proceed properly."
And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: How is it, everyone? Today's outfit is a special witch costume I got as a reward for pulling off some big magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Even this exchange event happened in a snap thanks to my magic!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Sweeeep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ In that case, I'll show you
some amazing magic here too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, Sweep has a totally different vibe today
compared to usual!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's the outfit, but she feels so grown-up!
I wonder what kind of performance it'll be!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? The next song is already the last one?
No no no! I wanna sing more!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: When I say I'm gonna sing, I'm gonna sing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's the Sweepy I know!
The best—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Grown-up Sweep is nice, but
I still love her selfish side too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the newborn Sweepy, one step closer to becoming a great witch, you know!?
So I'm gonna show you even more magic!

Even in her new witch attire, as enchanting as ever...
her charm remained unchanged as she continued
to cast her spell on everyone around her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ouch!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now—!
This skirt is way too long!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Do your best--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Look at you, standing up all by yourself! What a good girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
This is nothing to me!

"Undeterred by minor accidents,
Sweep Tosho powered through with determination,
shining even brighter than usual."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Reach them! My magic!
May everyone smile~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The performance is different from before, and today Sweep
seems strangely calm and collected, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"It's cute... No, that's not it...
This is... absolutely gorgeous!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna grow way, way more,
and bring smiles to the whole world with my magic!

The Fan Meet-and-Greet live concert
brought down the curtain as a massive success.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? The magical tool
I was planning to use isn't here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Jeez, what is the meaning of this?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, go for it, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's a little trouble like this?
I know plenty of other magical tricks to make everyone smile!

Sweep Tosho, having successfully pulled it off
despite the hardships, put on a concert that
was wildly exciting.
